title: 업무 드라이브(데몬 자동 업로드·분류·부서 접근, 파일 전용) 계약

crossYearFixture.description: 업무 드라이브는 ERP 원장을 읽거나 쓰지 않는다. 저장소는 data/drive 의 파일과 index.jsonl 뿐이며 MSSQL 연결을 열지 않는다. 파일명의 차수는 표시·분류용 문자열이고 OrderYear/OrderWeek 키를 만들지 않는다.

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe 기능이 아닌 웹 전용 화면. ERP 테이블 side effect 는 모두 preserve.
methods: Shared drive storage allows up to 100 GiB, bounded by indexed usage plus filesystem available bytes above a 5 GiB operating reserve; new writes are refused when free space cannot be measured. Admin usage reports available bytes; 507 rejects files above the effective limit.
Invoice PDF ↔ result workbook pairing from data/drive/index.jsonl → data/drive/pairs.json (lib/workDrivePairs, admin-only GET /api/work/drive-pairs, no SQL)

Web direct uploads mirrored into data/drive via lib/workDrive.mirrorWebUpload (hostname 'web', eventType 'web-upload', source=feature path); never throws, upload API responses unchanged, no SQL (2026-11-09)

pairWorker: Invoice/workbook pair derivation runs in one bounded worker per web process. Ingest still persists and classifies the file and completes the same existing remit stage before awaiting pair derivation. Pair failures still do not fail the upload. Admin GET/POST response fields and matching algorithm remain unchanged; cold GET and manual recompute await the worker. Queued requests coalesce; unchanged immutable workbook sheet names are cached by path/SHA/stat; worker locks serialize publishers across processes and output is atomic. No added MSSQL queries or writes; original file bytes/index/classification/permissions/remit logic unchanged.
